messages:
incident_bot: P0 alert — Peridot Systems (tenant: peridot-prod) vpc-peridot dedicated pool GPU saturation >98% for 7m. Queue length=420, error spike on /api/generate (429s). Impact: degraded throughput for Peridot enterprise customers. Paging oncall_miguel. Incident link: https://redwood.ops/incidents/RWI-2026-805

oncall_miguel: Ack. I'm on it :rotating_light:

sre_amy: Looking now — pulling metrics from prometheus and allocator logs.

eng_runtime_tony: FYI I see the autoscaler has burst_enabled=false for that pool in the control plane config. Could explain why reserve wasn't used.

oncall_miguel: Can confirm. `GET /v1/pools/vpc-peridot/config` shows "burst_enabled": false and "max_burst_gpus": 0. Need an emergency decision: flip burst or move GPUs from spare-reserved.

prod_owner_jess: Peridot is on an enterprise plan with emergency burst in their contract. Nadia (acct exec) — can you confirm approval?

acct_exec_nadia: Confirmed — authorize emergency burst for up to 4 GPUs for 2 hours. Notifying CS and legal.

support_lina: Peridot_ops pinged us, they report many failed jobs and increased latency. They're asking for ETA on mitigation.

peridot_ops: Seeing 10–15% job failures and big tail latency. Appreciate fast action.

oncall_miguel: Applying manual burst now:
```
# admin action (internal)
./admin/burst --pool vpc-peridot --gpus 4 --duration 2h --reason "emergency: tenant saturation"
```

incident_bot: Action started: burst job queued (id: burst-8091234567-1). Runbook step 3 executed.

eng_runtime_tony: Allocator log snippet: `2026-05-12T14:12:09Z Assigned 4 GPUs from reserved-spare to vpc-peridot (burst-8091234567-1) in 38s`

sre_amy: Metrics after allocation: pool GPU util dropping from 100% -> 76% in 3m. Queue length trending down: 420 -> 90. 429 rate dropping.

peridot_ops: Confirming — throughput improving on our end. Thanks.

prod_owner_jess: Good. Temporary mitigation in place. Next: 1) keep burst for 2h (or until queue clears), 2) investigate why autoscaler policy prevented burst, 3) add guardrails to avoid billing surprises. Assigning eng-runtime + SRE for postmortem.

oncall_miguel: Handing to eng_runtime_tony for longer-term fix. I'll mark oncall clear but remain available.

eng_runtime_tony: Taking ownership. Immediate tasks: reproduce the config pathology, add validation to control plane so burst_enabled=false only if explicitly requested in contract, and write an integr test. Also will add an alert that triggers when queue >200 for >5m even if util==100%.

acct_exec_nadia: I've emailed Peridot with incident summary and offered a 2h credit for disruption. Customer asked for timeline on root cause — will coordinate with eng.

support_lina: I'll keep the customer channel open and post updates. Planning to close pager once 429s < 1% for 15m.

incident_bot: Resolved: Peridot GPU saturation mitigated by manual burst allocation. Duration ~46m. Incident ID RWI-2026-805. Resolution summary: allocated 4 spare GPUs to vpc-peridot; queue drained; autoscaler config bug identified (burst_enabled false). Postmortem owners: eng-runtime_tony, sre_amy, prod_owner_jess.

peridot_ops: Appreciate the quick response — we'll monitor and report if anything else pops up.

sre_amy: Adding follow-ups: postmortem doc, revert any temporary throttles on lower-tier tenants if applied, and verify billing adjustments.

acct_exec_nadia: Customer happy with outreach. 👍

prod_owner_jess: Thanks team. Closing the active pager. Please add timeline and logs to RWI-2026-805 ticket.

oncall_miguel: Clear from on-call. Good job everyone. :raised_hands:
